newsitem.title: USA: Hurricane Isidore weakens as it heads north.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane Isidore weakens as it heads north.

text.p: Hurricane Isidore weakened on Sunday as it headed north into the cooler waters of the North Atlantic, the National Hurricane Center said.
At 11 a.m. EDT (1500 GMT), the center of Isidore was at latitude 21.8 north, longitude 41.1 west, about 1,400 miles (2,250 km) south-southwest of the Azores and moving northeast at 13 mph (20 kph).
Maximum sustained winds were down to 75 mph (120 kph), making Isidore a minimal hurricane, and were expected to decrease further on Sunday, forecasters said.
The storm was expected to resume a more northerly track in the next 24 hours.
Isidore's track seemed likely to keep it away from the U.S. East Coast and Bermuda, the British island territory that lies well east of the North Carolina coast in the Atlantic.
